inspiration.observed_pattern: An event table joins a grouped derived table of per-type averages, filters observations above their type average, and groups entities with HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT event_type) to require multiple qualifying types.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as an account campaign audit. A derived average per activity kind is joined back to event rows and account labels, while grouped HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT activity_kind) retains accounts exceeding the average in more than one kind. The source schema, names, values, and business context are not copied.

fixture_notes: Account 103 exceeds the independently computed activity-kind averages in both kinds and qualifies; account 102 exceeds only purchase, while accounts 101 and 104 do not qualify. Two purchase rows for account 103 make COUNT(DISTINCT activity_kind) observable.
determinism_notes: Account IDs, labels, event IDs, activity kinds, counts, derived averages, grouping keys, threshold comparison, and final ordering are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE campaign_accounts (account_id INT PRIMARY KEY, account_label VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE campaign_events (event_id INT PRIMARY KEY, account_id INT NOT NULL, activity_kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, activity_count INT NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT a.account_id, a.account_label FROM campaign_accounts AS a JOIN campaign_events AS e ON e.account_id = a.account_id JOIN (SELECT activity_kind, AVG(activity_count) AS average_count FROM campaign_events GROUP BY activity_kind) AS thresholds ON thresholds.activity_kind = e.activity_kind WHERE e.activity_count > thresholds.average_count GROUP BY a.account_id, a.account_label HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.activity_kind) > 1 ORDER BY a.account_id

checks.sql: SELECT a.account_id, a.account_label FROM campaign_accounts AS a JOIN campaign_events AS e ON e.account_id = a.account_id JOIN (SELECT activity_kind, AVG(activity_count) AS average_count FROM campaign_events GROUP BY activity_kind) AS thresholds ON thresholds.activity_kind = e.activity_kind WHERE e.activity_count > thresholds.average_count GROUP BY a.account_id, a.account_label HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.activity_kind) > 1 ORDER BY a.account_id
SELECT account_id, account_label FROM campaign_accounts ORDER BY account_id
